summary: Part 1 of 3 (00:00-03:34) of the Orders App (Seller) training walks a seller through the Revibe admin Orders list and order detail pages: the stage groups shown on the list (02. Order created, 03. At quality check, 04. Shipped, 05. Delivered), the order columns (Order Help, WH, order-number country prefixes, tracking, cost, payment), opening an order in the side panel, View Details, Edit, and the Comments box. The pack title carries the TBU (to be updated) label. Several narrated sentences are cut off, so the Request Revibe meaning, the 'fulfillment' delivery option, 'supplier view' and the cost definition are left as unclear. All 40 frames listed in the pack were opened.

asr_fixes.basis: Group header on screen reads '03. At quality check (4)'.
Delivery Method values on screen are 'Standard'. The word 'fulfillment' is not on screen (see unclear).
Left menu item on screen is 'Order Mana...'.
Button label on screen reads 'View Details'.

unclear.issue: The sentence about requests for Revibe ('If there is a request that has been made for Revive, the model, the variation, the delivery method, so either standard or fulfillment?') is cut off. It is not clear what 'Request Revibe' means, and 'fulfillment' is not visible on screen. Only 'Standard' appears as a delivery method.
The trainer says 'orders management and supplier view' but no supplier view appears on screen. Only the 'Order Mana...' menu item is shown.

The definition of cost ('the price that you mentioned in your price sheet or in ...') is cut off, and the continuation ('the payment app and information related to the customer') does not make clear what Actual Cost is based on.
The trainer says Edit lets you change 'some information' but does not say which fields. On the edit page only some fields look editable, and this is not confirmed.
'Quality check is when basically you do your quality check' does not say what the seller must check or do.
'the price that {put?} the payment and delivery method' has a garbled word, so the sentence is unclear.

The Revibe Installment Information section and the stepper buttons (Go to label, Request address..., Ready for pickup, Not ready for pickup, Download) are shown on screen but never explained. Whether they are clickable actions is not known.
The narration says 'this order has been placed 13 hours ago' without naming the order. The pointer is on the first row (61021-1, WH 13), so the link to that order is implied, not stated.

outdated.signal: The pack title flags this video as '(TBU)', meaning to be updated, so the workflow may change.
Stage counts on screen (6, 4, 19, 442) and the total of 476 orders are a snapshot from the recording and will change.
Order dates on screen run from 11/11/2024 to 25/03/2025 and are example data.

privacy.what: Real customer personal data is visible in the Order List (Name, Address, City, Phone Number, Email columns), in the order side panel and on the full order page for order 61021-1 (customer name, phone number, email, street address), and for many other orders in the list. Frames include t00091, t00097, t00107, t00122, t00129, t00134, t00192, t00196, t00202. Do not share these screens with sellers without redaction.
The Last Updated By column shows a Revibe staff email address on the ZA-4414-1 row (frame t00112). The Email column on that same row shows a customer address. This is staff data.

The Logs area shows an internal Revibe admin email in the small 'Updated by' text of the Shipment Status Logs entry (frame t00196). This is staff data; the text is small and was read with low certainty.
